cosy-lesson.title: "Algorithms and AI are the opposite of taking risks...": Madonna (B2)

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Audacity – a willingness to take bold risks.

p.em: Example: His artistic audacity pushed him to paint a massive mural across the city hall.

cosy-blockquote.p: Heuristics – enabling someone to discover or learn something for themselves; problem-solving processes.

p.em: Example: Modern recommendation algorithms rely on user heuristics to suggest new songs.

cosy-blockquote.p: Mechanical – lacking emotional warmth, spontaneity, or soul; automatic.

p.em: Example: The pianist played with perfect accuracy, but the performance felt too mechanical.

cosy-blockquote.p: Subversive – seeking or intended to subvert or challenge an established system or institution.

p.em: Example: The novelist wrote a highly subversive satire criticizing the authoritarian government.

cosy-blockquote.p: Artisanal – relating to or characteristic of an artisan; hand-made with traditional craftsmanship.

p.em: Example: Consumers are willing to pay more for high-quality artisanal bread from local bakers.

cosy-blockquote.p: Ingenuity – the quality of being clever, original, and inventive.

p.em: Example: The design team showed great ingenuity in fitting a complete kitchen into a tiny studio.

cosy-blockquote.p: Standardization – the process of making something conform to a standard, expected pattern.

p.em: Example: The extreme standardization of modern architecture has made cities look identical.

cosy-blockquote.p: Expressiveness – the quality of effectively conveying a thought, feeling, or soul.

p.em: Example: The dancer's incredible expressiveness left the entire audience in silent awe.

cosy-blockquote.p: Genuineness – the quality of being authentic, real, or true.

p.em: Example: The absolute genuineness of her apology was felt by everyone in the room.

cosy-blockquote.p: Serendipity – the occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.

p.em: Example: Wandering through a quiet alley led us to a gorgeous bookstore by pure serendipity.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
How does Madonna's lifelong artistic audacity demonstrate that iconoclasm requires taking real public risks?
★ Have you ever taken a public stance or artistic risk that shocked people around you?

Why do algorithmic heuristics prioritize safe, predictable trends over groundbreaking performance art?
★ Do you notice your music streaming apps recommending safe, familiar tracks rather than surprising new genres?

Why does a completely mechanical pop show lack the danger and electrifying energy of a live, unpredictable performance?
★ Have you ever attended a concert where a performer made a mistake that actually made the show more memorable?

How can a subversive stage spectacle push cultural boundaries and force society to re-examine taboo topics?
★ Which pop culture icon in your lifetime do you consider the most fearlessly subversive?

How does traditional artisanal songwriting differ from data-optimized track assembly line production?
★ Do you appreciate songs with complex lyrics and structure more than repetitive radio hooks?

In what ways does raw human ingenuity thrive when artists intentionally defy platform guidelines?
★ When working on projects, do you prefer following set guidelines or inventing your own approach?

Why does the corporate standardization of entertainment threaten to eliminate rebellious pop figures?
★ Do you feel that current pop stars take fewer risks than musicians did thirty years ago?

Can an algorithm ever capture the dramatic emotional expressiveness of a singer confronting public controversy?
★ How do you express your strongest emotions when you feel misunderstood by others?

Why is absolute genuineness essential for a star who builds a career on challenging societal norms?
★ How do you judge whether an artist is being true to themselves or just chasing publicity?

How does spontaneous stage serendipity create iconic cultural moments that cannot be planned by algorithms?
★ Can you recall an unscripted moment in entertainment that became an instant legendary memory?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Algorithm-driven music production will eliminate the audacity needed to launch revolutionary subcultures. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you support an artist who intentionally sabotaged their commercial success to stay rebellious?

Relying on predictive market heuristics will result in a decade of repetitive, risk-free pop music. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you worry that future generations won't experience truly groundbreaking musical movements?

Audiences have become too comfortable with mechanical perfection to appreciate unscripted, flawed live art. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you prefer auto-tuned vocal perfection or authentic live singing with natural flaws?

True subversive provocations will disappear because streaming platforms immediately censor risky content. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you think online platforms censor controversial artistic expression too aggressively?

Handcrafted artisanal music will become an expensive luxury product for a small elite of connoisseurs. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you pay extra money to purchase vinyl records or physical media to support independent artists?

Human ingenuity will always invent new ways to mock and subvert AI-generated pop culture. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you believe human creators will always stay one step ahead of generative AI models?

The standardization of music by algorithms will trigger a violent cultural backlash toward raw punk energy. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Are you ready for a new wave of raw, unpolished music that rejects digital perfection?

Synthetic vocal expressiveness will soon replace real singers in major theatrical and cinematic productions. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you feel cheated if a movie soundtrack featured an AI voice instead of a living human vocalist?

Raw genuineness and willingness to suffer public backlash are the only things AI can never simulate. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ What makes a human artist's life story important to how you evaluate their art?

An era dominated by algorithmic choices makes true artistic serendipity nearly impossible to experience. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How do you discover new music or art without relying on digital algorithm recommendations?

ul.li: Incorrect: The AI can to make art → Correct: AI can make art ((Can + infinitive without 'to', omit 'the' for general technology))
Incorrect: I am agree with Madonna → Correct: I agree with Madonna ((Agree is a verb))
Incorrect: It depend of your preference → Correct: It depends on your preference ((Depends + on, singular verb s))
